summary: The requested source checks and twelve independent samples pass. Three remaining report claims are wrong: the history section still maps IDs, Green logs do not carry dispositions, and coverage logs do not end with test summaries.
blocking_findings: F43 [Blocker] review-a: report.md:175,179 retains finding-to-role mapping and per-finding dispositions after PM decision C limited Finding history to source pointers, file counts, and highest IDs. Line 175 maps F1-F3 to Review A and Acceptance. Line 179 names F17, F26, F10, F11, F16, and F18 with statuses. Remove these mappings and statuses.

F44 [Blocker] review-a: report.md:173 says each green-*.log holds a dispositions line. A search of every green-*.log in the run directory finds no such line. These paths are test-run logs, not Green role result logs. Replace the pointer with the actual role-artifact path or remove the claim.

F45 [Blocker] review-a: report.md:33,63 says the cited logs end with a passing test summary. The sampled COVERAGE logs end with a coverage table, not a test summary. The coverage logs for 4d1688131, bcaa97ff4, and both reruns show a final Coverage summary and line percentages. State separately what the GREEN and COVERAGE logs contain.

The exact role range a0b229def673fb476ad2ded5719f54431d94511d..997662659f962202e3314605f39ee5fbd8fcbf3b changes report.md and plan.md only. The Phase 4 range e91c4d4cc3c8d5d61a1e9b802c031247543180fa..HEAD adds report.md and changes plan.md. The apps/ diff is empty.

The line-number citation scan `grep -nE ':[[:space:]]*[0-9]+'` returns no matches. Matches for the broad word `line` refer to coverage metrics and a test filename, not citations.

The report's Finding history counts match the run files: 20 pre-existing Review A JSON files, 13 adversarial JSON files, 7 phase-acceptance JSON files, and 3 second-check JSON files. The 21st Review A JSON is this provisional audit artifact.
The cited highest IDs match their JSONs: review-a-cb12d6f.json has F30, adversarial-e91c4d4.json has ADV-24, and phase-acceptance-a0b229d.json has F42.

F33 verified: proof-adv8.log and proof-adv11.log each fail a `.md` extension assertion and also fail discovery assertions for their `.mdx` or uppercase `.MD` probes. Report.md:86 separates the discovery checks from the `.md` naming assertion.

F34 verified: the report names green-4d168813.log and coverage-4d168813.log, plus green-bcaa97f.log and coverage-bcaa97f.log. All four paths exist. The Green logs end with passing test totals; the coverage logs end with coverage tables.
F38 verified: review-a-c673f21.json says only the unused beforeEach import predates Phase 2; it says D5 part 2 made sectionOf and copy unused. Report.md:78 preserves that distinction.
F41 verified: blog-posts-loader.ts:121 checks `file.endsWith('.md')` before parsing. The file sweep separately lists entries, while loadAllPosts parses only the exact lowercase suffix.
The claimed Green-log disposition pointers do not exist: searching all green-*.log files finds no line starting `dispositions:`.
Eight sampled log paths exist. The four GREEN logs end with passing test totals. The four COVERAGE logs end with a `Coverage summary` and percentage rows, not a test summary.
Independent sample 1: all fourteen commit SHAs named in the class and remediation tables resolve with `git cat-file -e`.
Independent sample 2: baseline.json and baseline.log report 3175 cases and 86.52 percent line coverage.
Independent sample 3: gate-66aeb1011.json and green-66aeb1011.log report 1412 cases and 92.07 percent line coverage.
Independent sample 4: the case reduction is 1763, or 55.53 percent of 3175; the 20 percent target is 635 cases. Report.md:10 rounds to 55.5 percent.
Independent sample 5: baseline and final line coverage differ by 5.55 points, matching report.md:10.
Independent sample 6: gate-257a6b0c.json records 3094 cases before and 1385 after the merge, a 1709-case reduction. The validation file falls from 1726 cases to 17.
Independent sample 7: without the merge, 1412 plus 1709 gives 3121 cases; 3175 minus 3121 is 54 cases, or 1.70 percent.
Independent sample 8: classification.md:226-234 gives K 2843, D1 67, D2 22, D3 0, D4 6, D5 221, R1 0, R2 16, and R3 0; the classes sum to 3175.
Independent sample 9: classification.md:240-248 projects a 176-to-196 case cut, or 5.5-to-6.2 percent, before the blog merge.
Independent sample 10: baseline.log reports 90.47 seconds and green-66aeb1011.log reports 98.11 seconds. Their difference is 7.64 seconds.
Independent sample 11: timing-at-head.json recomputes the five largest assertion-duration sums as 6461.93, 1649.38, 1303.32, 970.85, and 859.77 ms.
Independent sample 12: report.md's K table has 77 rows and 2843 cases. Its role-history file counts and highest IDs match the run artifacts. No model names occur in the report.
The report's twelve requested independent claims check out. The three blockers concern added Finding history and log-summary statements.
